semiconductor_relevance: High — GMT Global Inc. manufactures inspection and measurement equipment relevant to the semiconductor industry.
summary: GMT Global Inc. specializes in automation solutions, focusing on linear motion components and optical testing systems for the semiconductor sector. They aim to enhance manufacturing efficiency and support the transition to intelligent factories through innovative technologies.

regional_presence.Taiwan: Headquartered in Taiwan, GMT Global Inc. operates with a strong focus on local manufacturing and R&D.
regional_presence.China: The company has a subsidiary in China to enhance its operational capabilities in the region.
regional_presence.Germany: GMT Global Inc. has a subsidiary in Germany to support its European market presence.
